## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:reports`, into `pm:queue`. The report renderer classifies an analytics read refusal the way dataset widgets do and shows the shared no-access state

Triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-13T15:02Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Re-checked on `origin/main` (`72594f29ec`):** `plugin-dashboard`'s `DatasetWidget.tsx` (`:826`–`:832`) classifies a read refusal with the shared `classifyLoadError(e) === 'forbidden'` and renders its localized no-access panel. `plugin-report`'s `DatasetReportRenderer.tsx` has no such branch, so the adapter's message (`data-objectstack/src/index.ts:1414`, "Analytics query refused: …") reaches the page as an error box.
- **Why p2:** a permission wall reads as a failure, with the server's text and an object API name on screen. It was measured once in a browser, on HotCRM at 18.0.0-next.0 (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2093, finding 10). It matches the dashboard half's grade (#12112).
- **Lane:** `packages/plugin-report` is `domain:ui`.
- **Direction:**
  - The report renderer takes the same `classifyLoadError` branch and renders the same localized no-access state. ⛔ No matching on message text, and ⛔ no second classifier.
  - Any other failure keeps its error state, so a real error is not hidden behind "no access".
  - **Pins:** a 403 / `PERMISSION_DENIED` from the dataset query renders the no-access state with no server text; a 500 still renders the error.
- **App half:** whether this persona sees the entry at all is objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2060 item 5.
- Triage: lands in `packages/plugin-report/src/DatasetReportRenderer.tsx` (`domain:ui`); rationale: one refusal, one state, on every analytics surface.

Claim: PM loop round 5, next slot. The direction is triage `6148556640`: the report renderer classifies an analytics read refusal the way dataset widgets do, and shows the shared no-access state.
- `DatasetReportRenderer`'s dataset read takes the shared `classifyLoadError(e) === 'forbidden'` branch that `plugin-dashboard`'s `DatasetWidget` takes, and renders a localized no-access state with no server text.
- ⛔ No matching on message text, and ⛔ no second classifier.
- Any other failure keeps its error state, so a real error is not hidden behind "no access".

- **The renderer:** `packages/plugin-report/src/DatasetReportRenderer.tsx`.
  - `useDatasetRows` (`:490`) sets `{ status: 'error', error: String(e.message) }` in its `.catch` (`:599`–`:604`), with no classification.
  - `FetchStates` (`:652`) draws that string in a red box. Its three callers are `:744`, `:1214` (a silent fallback to the table) and `:1565`.
- **Possibly** an i18n key in `packages/i18n/src/locales/*`, only if no existing key's wording fits a report (`list.loadErrorForbidden*` and `dashboard.widgetForbidden*` exist).
- Co-located tests and a changeset.
- ⛔ No new export, prop or spec key unless the report justifies it.
- ⛔ `plugin-dashboard`'s `DatasetWidget.tsx` and `data-objectstack` are read, not changed.
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier — dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui: "no path-derived mandate"`
Clause-②: no
Clause-② reason:
- This changes only how a refusal the renderer already receives is drawn.
- No published type, export or accepted input moves, and none of the three contract surfaces is touched.
Responsibility: `@object-ui/plugin-report's DatasetReportRenderer (a 403 from the dataset query is drawn as the adapter's raw message) | none | every console user who opens a report whose dataset object they may not read; measured on the card in a browser on HotCRM at 18.0.0-next.0 (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2093, finding 10)`
Thread-read: 6148556640
Serial constraints cleared: read at 2026-10-13T15:59Z on objectui `main` `72594f29ec`.
- No open PR touches `packages/plugin-report/src/` (objectui#11845, #11844 and #11600 read).
- This seat's objectui#12030 dev changes only `packages/plugin-report/package.json` there (the `@objectstack/*` ranges). Whichever lands second resolves.

## Landed: objectui PR #12340 → `main` `2b06a91` · `domain:ui` seat 1 · `session_01CsyMRsFJBKNEMa4oPY1b5z` · 2026-10-14T01:11Z

- Merged through the merge queue at 2026-10-14T01:09Z. This card closed `completed` by the PR's `Fixes #12330`. No other card closed at the merge.
- **Landed by content:** all 14 of the PR's files on `main` `2b06a91e64` are blob-identical to the accepted head `3a680c5`.
  - ACCEPT: `6158434366`.
  - Contract review: `6158418040`, opus, under waiver `6158097279`. The earlier fable FAIL `6158000763` is answered by the `minor` level.
- **The CI re-run** on that head confirmed objectui#12344 (the OAuth consent page's timing flake), which is filed.
- `pm:dispatched` was removed and read back.
- The changesets ride the next objectui release: `@object-ui/plugin-report` `patch` and `@object-ui/i18n` `minor`.
- **What is on `main`:** a report whose dataset query is refused for reading (403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`, judged by the shared `classifyLoadError`) shows the localized no-access state: "You don't have access", plus the new `report.forbiddenMessage` in all ten language packs.
  - No server text and no object name is drawn.
  - The state covers the table, summary, cross-tab and joined blocks, and a report with a chart shows it once.
  - Any other failure keeps its error box and message.
- **The app half** (whether `service.agent` sees the entry at all) remains objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2060 item 5.
